prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: low-speed head-on collision in League City, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported neck strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1295; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative: On arrival at the scene in League City, Texas, I observed two passenger vehicles in a head-on collision in the eastbound lane of the roadway. Driver 1 was operating the northbound vehicle and stated that the other vehicle crossed into the lane of travel while Driver 2 was operating the southbound vehicle. Driver 2 stated that Driver 1 drifted left at low speed prior to impact. Both vehicles sustained front-end damage consistent with a low-speed impact, and both vehicles were drivable with assistance and were removed from the roadway. A Passenger in the northbound vehicle remained seated and declined medical transport at the scene. Driver 1 reported neck strain and stiffness and was transported by a private vehicle to a local medical facility for evaluation. No citations were issued at the scene. Weather was clear and the road surface was dry. Statements were collected from all parties, and photographs of both vehicles and the roadway were taken.
